comments.body: Flag keys proposed as rate_limit.soft_warn_headers with project override support.

content.text: Flag keys proposed as rate_limit.soft_warn_headers with project override support.
The soft rate-limit warning headers experiment needs controlled rollout rather than a global config flip.
Add feature flags that enable warning headers per project or plan tier and emit whether the header was sent for analysis.
Default the experiment off in production until the analytics dashboard is wired.

description_text:
